title: Reminders
description: Every reminder here is off until you turn it on. Pick the ones you want and the time they arrive.

globalMaster.label: Notifications enabled
globalMaster.hint: One switch for every reminder, routines included. Your times are kept while it is off.

cbt.title: CBT check-in
cbt.body: Notice a thought and meet it with more balance.

act.title: ACT check-in
act.body: Notice an unhelpful thought and gently unhook from it.

meditation.title: Time to meditate
meditation.body: Take a few minutes to settle your attention.

mood.title: Mood check-in
mood.body: Take a few seconds - how are you feeling?

journal.title: Time to journal
journal.body: A few lines about your day can help it make sense.

gratitude.title: A moment of gratitude
gratitude.body: What's one small thing you're grateful for?

grounding.title: A grounding moment
grounding.body: Pause and reconnect with your senses for a minute.

breathing.title: Time to breathe
breathing.body: A short break to settle your body and mind.

sleep.title: Wind down for sleep
sleep.body: Log how you slept and ease into a restful night.

habits.title: Time for your habits
habits.body: Take a quick look at today's habits.

routine.title: Your routine
routine.body: A couple of small steps, whenever you're ready.

reminderPrompt.title: Nice work. Want a daily reminder?
reminderPrompt.description: A gentle nudge for {{label}} around this time each day. You can change or turn it off anytime.

saveErrors.missing-user: You need to be signed in to set up reminders.
saveErrors.missing-vapid-key: Reminders aren't configured for this app build.

permission-denied.web: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
permission-denied.native: Notifications are turned off for Selftend in your device settings.

saveErrors.service-worker-unavailable: Couldn't set up reminders on this browser.
saveErrors.subscription-failed: Couldn't set up reminders on this browser.
saveErrors.timeout: Couldn't reach this browser's notification service. Reminders may not work here.
